[[Category:Probability theory| 1]]
In [[probability theory]], the '''sample space''', denoted by $\Omega$, is the set of all possible '''elementary outcomes''' of an [[experiment]], denoted by $\omega_i$.

i.e.,
$$
\Omega=\{\omega_i\}
$$

== Examples ==

=== Coin toss ===

$$
\Omega=\{H,T\}.
$$

=== Dice roll ===

$$
\Omega=\{1,2,3,4,5,6\}.
$$

=== Waiting time for a bus ===

$$
\Omega=[0,\infty).
$$
